independent_queue_regressions.independent_scope: Original two failing queue probes and third regrade control are preserved/published by independent reviewer; the permanent file contains only the original two queue probes.

behavior: One persistent coordinator dispatches actual grading and import jobs; corrupt leading entries are isolated without scores or successful jobs.
Fixed assignment, submission, answer version/hash, grading result and private trace bindings are validated.
Real current author session is checked before signed manual review and replay; HMAC secret and actor session identity stay private.
Manual regrade adds immutable history and never approves imported private solutions.
Cancellation and shutdown prevent obsolete lease commits; expired jobs can be recovered with one terminal event.
No grade_finalized/evidence event or independent eligibility judgment is fabricated; result eligibility_status is not_evaluated.
limitations: Only backend scoped tests plus contract generation/type/lint evidence, not native/full-platform/exact-commit acceptance.
SQLite deliberate corruption probes are not claims of arbitrary SQL write access through the API.
Unrecoverable malformed legacy snapshots stay quarantined for explicit data repair, with originals preserved.
The publication scanner supplements manual review; it cannot prove absence of arbitrary private prose.
